procedures.title: Front suspension special tools
notes: Figure 14 (special tools) list, Corvette-relevant items: (1) J-5888-3 Support; (3) J-22944 Spring Remover (Corvette); (4) J-7052-2 Spacer; (5) J-7052-5 Installer; (9) J-8092 Driver Handle; (10) J-8849 Installer (outer bearing cup); (11) J-8850 Installer (inner bearing cup).
Also used in Corvette procedures but not in this list: J-7052-1 and the 7/16 x 20 and 3/8-24 capscrews furnished with J-5888.
Tools listed only for other models (e.g. J-22739 Chevelle/Camaro/Chevy II spring remover, J-9519 and J-21474/J-21058 series bushing and joint tools) are omitted.
